candidates.claim: The first DMZ_IN entry permits all IP traffic from the jump host 10.10.20.30 to 10.10.10.0/24, although the only approved jump-host service into OT is tcp/3389 to the engineering workstation 10.10.10.40.
candidates.remediation: Replace DMZ_IN entry fw-01:68 with a permit limited to tcp/3389 to 10.10.10.40 (A4), or remove it.

candidates.claim: The OT_IN entry at position 4 is the first match for OT tcp/443 traffic and permits it to any destination (0.0.0.0/0), which includes OUTSIDE, CORP and DMZ hosts, although no such cross-zone service is approved.
candidates.remediation: Remove OT_IN entry fw-01:80 or restrict it to an approved destination and service.

candidates.claim: sw-core-01 defines a read-write SNMP community with no ACL, while the management policy requires SNMP communities to be read-only and restricted by an MGMT-only ACL.
candidates.remediation: Remove the read-write community or make it read-only and bind it to an ACL that permits only MGMT hosts, such as SNMP_NMS.

candidates.claim: sw-ot-01 has a logging host at 192.168.30.77, which is in CORP and not inside MGMT as the management policy requires.
candidates.remediation: Remove the logging host 192.168.30.77 and keep logging only to the MGMT syslog server 10.10.99.60.
